source.note: Candidates require review of dynamic classes, public APIs, tests and assets before removal.

unitCoverage.scope: Only source modules loaded by Node unit tests; excludes DOM/E2E coverage and unloaded modules.

singleVideo.methodology: Fresh persistent Chromium profile for each size; actual ZIP export/import actions and IndexedDB; synthetic WebM MIME payloads; byte length and boundary verification of every video; JS heap sampled every 10ms, at Blob creation, stringify/parse and CDP checkpoints. Video decoding, download I/O and whole-process RSS are excluded.

Video decoding, download I/O and whole-process RSS are excluded.

scope: Primary Chromium test pages only. Debug enabled except Debug/idle-performance tests. UI response is event capture to two animation frames, not asynchronous action completion. Coverage is observed execution, not proof that unexercised code or CSS is obsolete. External extension contexts are verified separately.
